item.title: Cispe files competition complaint against Broadcom over VMware programme
item.description: The CISPE has lodged a competition complaint challenging Broadcom’s recent actions in the European cloud market.

item.title: Bandwidth on demand: the in-demand model with no demand. Yet.
item.description: A flexible utility model should, in theory, also allow customers to increase bandwidth at times of peak demand beyond normal usage.

item.title: Zoom rejuvenates its platform and the company with new agentic AI capabilities
item.description: Zoom's new capabilities reflect a broader implementation of agentic AI taking place on collaboration and contact centre platforms.

item.title: Intelligent infrastructure: How AI is transforming OTNs
item.description: Unveiled At MWC Barcelona 2026, Huawei’s next generation of optical transport networks (OTNs) is transforming their role from passive data pipelines into intelligent, integrated platforms, underpinning critical services across power, rail, government and beyond.

item.title: Zilliz launches CMEK to boost enterprise data control in cloud
item.description: Zilliz launched CMEK for Zilliz Cloud platform, enabling enterprises to maintain exclusive control over encryption keys securing their data.

item.title: Coralogix and Skyflow partner for privacy-focused observability in AI era
item.description: Coralogix and Skyflow formed a partnership to provide organisations with privacy-focused observability solutions for managing customer data.

item.title: Pondurance launches AI-powered SOC Kanati
item.description: Pondurance has announced the general availability of Kanati, its new Agentic AI designed to autonomously run security operations.

item.title: AWS Bahrain cloud services face disruption due to drone incident
item.description: AWS experienced a disruption in its Bahrain cloud region on Monday following reports of drone activity tied to ongoing Middle East conflict.

item.title: Broadcom launches Symantec CBX for under-resourced SOC teams
item.description: Broadcom has announced the launch of Symantec CBX, a cloud-based security platform that merges technologies from Symantec and Carbon Black.

item.title: Oracle launches agentic AI tools for enterprise data management
item.description: Oracle has introduced a series of agentic AI advancements to its AI Database platform to support organisations in developing AI applications.
